tal: Quick prep note — deploying llm-router v4.1 tonight at 23:59 UTC. Feature flag ff.llmroute.v41 will gate traffic. Rollout plan: 2% -> 15% after 10m -> 50% after 25m -> 100% after 45m. Hold at each step. We will enable a pinlock to model mr-v2.3.1 for canary + staged cohorts to prevent hot-swap drift. Quiet window 23:45-00:30 UTC. :eyes:

mika: Job db-90090 created. Requesting manual ack for the 15%->50% transition and explicit release-leads signoff before 100%. No auto-promote past 50%.

owen: Can we add a short "softfallback" to degraded v3 pool for 45s on first anomaly (to avoid full rollback noise) and a token-rate ceiling for the canary (900 tps) to avoid cache thundering?

tal: Yes to both. softfallback enabled (45s) and token cap applied for first 12m. Ack requirements set as requested.

tal: Quick reference commands for oncall ops: 

```bash
# emergency abort the deploy
deploybot abort db-90090 --reason "rollback: elevated error"
# turn the feature flag off immediately
redwoodctl flags set ff.llmroute.v41 0 --note "emergency revert"
# set a sticky pin (pinlock) for cohorts
redwoodctl runtime set-pin --service llm-router --model mr-v2.3.1 --cohorts canary,staged --sticky
# unpin cohorts
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-router --cohorts canary,staged
# force degraded fallback for a duration
redwoodctl routing set-fallback llm-router v3-degraded --duration 45
```

(ops: do not paste creds here) :lock:

deploybot: job=db-90090 scheduled by @tal. Auto-gates: p95 > 260ms OR 5xx > 0.6% sustained for 3m -> trigger softfallback. If anomaly persists 5m -> pause and page release-leads. Manual abort allowed for groups: release-leads, eng-oncall. Audit log enabled.

owen: I'll be watching p95, 5xx, kv_cache_miss, and model token-rate. If I call abort I'll paste the reason and graphs here.

mika: I'm on pager 23:40-00:40 UTC. I'll ack at each holdpoint after sanity checks. If I don't ack within 7m deploybot will hold and page eng-oncall.

tal: Starting canary now (2%). I'll post an update at each hold point. :rocket:

deploybot: Canary started — cohort=2% job=db-90090 step=canary-start ts=1844445555. Monitoring live.
